title: 12 Best Berlin's Vegan Food Scene
description: Discover the 12 best vegan restaurants in Berlin for 2026. From zero-waste fine dining to classic street food and donuts, explore top plant-based eateries in Mitte, Prenzlauer Berg, and more. Your ultimate guide to Berlin's vibrant vegan culinary scene.

places.name: Kopps
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The tasting menu for a full culinary journey, or their seasonal "Königsberger Klopse" if available.

places.name: Frea
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The evening tasting menu (their only option), which changes daily based on available produce.

places.name: Ryong
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The "The Crazy Crispy" (crispy rice, tofu, peanut sauce) or any of their signature Bao Burgers.

places.name: Brammibal's Donuts
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic "Maple Smoked Coconut Bacon" donut or a seasonal fruit-filled option.

places.name: Vöner
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The classic "Vöner Teller" with their signature sauce, or a "Vöner im Brot."

places.name: The Bowl
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The "Happy Bowl" for a well-rounded and satisfying meal, or their famous raw cheesecake for dessert.

places.name: Cookies Cream
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for the dedicated vegan tasting menu, or try their signature "Parmesan Dumplings" (vegan version available).

places.name: Alaska Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The "Patatas Bravas," "Croquetas," and their rotating seasonal specials.

places.name: Lia's Kitchen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The "Classic Burger" with their homemade patty, or the "Chili Cheese Burger" for something more indulgent.

places.name: Sfizy Veg
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The "Pizza Funghi e Tartufo" (mushroom and truffle oil) or any of their seasonal specials.

places.name: Chaostheorie
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their "Vöner Burger" or "Loaded Nachos" alongside one of their expertly crafted cocktails.

places.name: Swing Kitchen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The "Vienna Burger" or their crispy "Crispy Chickin Burger" with a side of fries and a vegan milkshake.
